newsitem.title: USA: Leviathan Gas to retain 50 pct lease stake.
newsitem.headline: Leviathan Gas to retain 50 pct lease stake.

text.p: Leviathan Gas Pipeline Partners LP said on Monday it elected to retain 50 percent of the working interests in three offshore leases that were acquired in June 1995 from Tatham Offshore Inc.

Under the terms of the lease acquisition, Leviathan is entitled to retain all of the proceeds from the properties until recovery of its acquisition costs, the drilling and development costs and a 15 percent return on those investments.
Alternatively, it has the option to retain up to 50 percent of the acquired properties by making a corresponding reduction in the balance of the payout account as of the date of election.
Leviathan said it would continue to receive 100 percent of the proceeds from the sale of oil and natural gas from the properties until the payout account is reduced to zero.
Tatham Offshore will receive an assignment of 50 percent of the working interests in the properties once payout has been achieved.
